title: MediaCloud API (v4) Wrapper
text: goal mediacloud2 make Media Cloud news archive usable R. Media Cloud collects online news tens thousands outlets worldwide lets search archive keyword, outlet, country date. package wraps version 4 Media Cloud API, replaced retired v2 API older R clients written . Everything package returns tibble, results go straight usual data wrangling plotting code.
